name: Radiant Capital rUSDCn index-rounding drain
summary: Radiant (an Aave v2 fork) listed a native USDC market 15 seconds before the exploit. As its only supplier, the attacker inflated the empty reserve's liquidity index with repeated flash loans whose premiums accrued to its tiny supply, then used rounding in rUSDCn burns to withdraw more than it held while borrowing WETH.
notes: The LendingPool's flash-loan index accrual is half of the defect; its reset is the same multisig batch that listed native USDC (rUSDCn aToken address written into reserves[USDC]), so both targets age from that listing.
Loss is the WETH the rWETH reserve paid out against debt the attacker's throwaway contracts never repaid. The October 2024 Radiant multisig key compromise is a separate, out-of-cohort event.
